name: Foundation
purpose: a repo where any agent can build, test and run everything, with the data layer, sign-in and desktop shell in place.
exit_gate: RLS isolation tests pass against real Postgres; sign-in works on Windows 11 and Linux from installed packages; `just check` green on the Linux and Windows CI runners.
traps: do not let the desktop renderer touch tokens or the network; keep `nodeIntegration` off and `contextIsolation` and `sandbox` on from the first commit. Do not develop the node inside WSL on Windows; it must be tested as a native Windows binary.
note: `passes` is set only by CI after a task's acceptance tests pass there. Dependencies default to the previous task in the phase; loosen them when tasks are independent. Areas are a first guess; one agent per area at a time.

tasks.title: Repo skeleton: workspace, every crate folder with `AGENTS.md`, `justfile`, toolchain pin, `.env.example`, dev compose.
spec_refs: README: Scope and production bar, Components and contracts, Data model (Server: Postgres), Security model (Identity and sessions, Tenancy and scopes), Operations (Repo layout, CI).
acceptance: RLS isolation (cross-tenant reads, writes and deletes fail for every table); token refresh reuse detection; device keys are stored only in the keychain (test reads the stored item and the registered public key only) on Windows Credential Manager and Linux Secret Service; the desktop starts the node and shows sign-in on Windows and Linux in CI; the renderer opens no network connection and the node opens no listening port; the MSIX installs, starts and uninstalls cleanly.
tasks.notes: Workspace, 21 crates plus server and node, justfile, dev compose, .env.example, toolchain pin, agent files.

tasks.notes: The Windows leg of CI was run by hand on a real Windows 11 machine: fmt, clippy -D warnings and 76 tests for the node, core, protocol and xtask crates; desktop typecheck, lint, 46 unit tests and build; 13 end-to-end tests.
